name: Angels' Uprising
description:
About This Game

Angels’ Uprising

Angels’ Uprising is a stylish platformer action game set in a modern reinterpretation of Hell,
where players use a spear as both a weapon and a traversal tool.

With the spear, players can perform stylish movement—leaping across long distances, avoiding obstacles, and moving freely in 360 degrees.
The spear can also be used to impale enemies, block attacks, and interact with the environment.

Unique Movement Using the Spear

The most important core mechanic in Angels’ Uprising is a movement system based on anchoring.

The spear can be embedded into walls, ceilings, or the ground.
Jumping while the spear is anchored propels the player with acceleration in the opposite direction.

This allows players to jump higher, traverse walls, hang from ceilings, and move dynamically through the environment.

Not all surfaces can be anchored to.
Some walls allow anchoring, while others do not—requiring players to carefully plan where and how to anchor the spear in order to progress.

Unique Combat Using the Spear

In Angels’ Uprising, the spear is the player’s only weapon.
However, its functionality is far from simple.

The spear does not stop after killing a single enemy.
Reflecting its ability to pierce through targets, players can impale multiple enemies lined up in a row with a single thrust, creating a uniquely satisfying sense of impact.

The spear is not only used against enemies.
Players can impale environmental objects—such as explosive gas canisters—and throw them as weapons.
Even the bodies of impaled enemies can be picked up and used as projectiles.

Story

After death, you are brought before the judgment of the angels.
However, due to the interference of an unknown entity, you are cast not into Heaven, but into Hell.

Armed with nothing but a single spear, you must push forward, piercing your way through demons.

Along your journey, you will encounter a mysterious rebel faction, the residents of Hell, powerful Archdemons who command the forces of evil, and a mysterious angel who watches over you.

You will eventually become involved in a secret plan known as “Angels’ Uprising.”
Will you uncover the truth of Heaven and Hell, and find the path to reincarnation?

Hell Awaits You

Leap across Hell with a single spear in hand,
and pierce through everything that stands in your way.

Controls

  • Left Mouse Button – Thrust spear (attack, anchor to surfaces)

  • Right Mouse Button – Block, throw objects impaled on the spear

  • A – Move left

  • D – Move right

  • Space – Jump

  • E – Interact, advance dialogue

  • F – Fast-forward dialogue

  • Q – Carry ally

  • F1 – Hide UI

  • F3 – Toggle developer mode

  • F11 – Toggle fullscreen
